# Time Out

> Global city guide covering things to do, events, food, drink, travel, hotels, movies, music and local culture.

Time Out helps people discover the best of cities worldwide through editorial recommendations, event coverage, restaurant and bar guides, travel inspiration, hotel picks, film and music coverage, and city-specific listings.

## Core Sections
- [News](https://www.timeout.com/news): Latest Time Out reporting on city life, culture, openings and trends.
- [Things to Do](https://www.timeout.com/things-to-do): Editorial picks for attractions, events, activities and local experiences.
- [Food & Drink](https://www.timeout.com/food-and-drink): Restaurant, bar, café and nightlife recommendations across major cities.
- [Travel](https://www.timeout.com/travel): Travel inspiration, destination guides and trip-planning features.
- [Hotels](https://www.timeout.com/hotels): Hotel recommendations and accommodation guides for popular destinations.
- [Movies](https://www.timeout.com/movies): Film reviews, movie news, rankings and cinema-related features.
- [Music](https://www.timeout.com/music): Music news, concert coverage, artist features and playlists.
- [Time Out Market](https://www.timeout.com/discover-timeout-markets): Guide to Time Out Market food halls and vendor experiences.

## City Guides
- [New York](https://www.timeout.com/newyork): City guide to events, restaurants, attractions and neighborhood culture in New York.
- [London](https://www.timeout.com/london): Comprehensive guide to London events, food, theatre, nightlife and local discoveries.
- [Chicago](https://www.timeout.com/chicago): Chicago recommendations for dining, arts, events and things to do.
- [Los Angeles](https://www.timeout.com/los-angeles): Los Angeles guide to entertainment, restaurants, beaches and city experiences.
- [Paris](https://www.timeout.com/paris): Paris coverage spanning museums, dining, nightlife and cultural events.
- [Barcelona](https://www.timeout.com/barcelona): Barcelona guide to food, beaches, attractions and local happenings.
- [Madrid](https://www.timeout.com/madrid): Madrid recommendations for culture, dining, nightlife and city activities.
- [Tokyo](https://www.timeout.com/tokyo): Tokyo city guide with events, restaurants, neighborhoods and travel ideas.

## Arts & Culture
- [Art](https://www.timeout.com/art): Coverage of exhibitions, galleries, museums and visual arts news.
- [Theatre](https://www.timeout.com/theatre): Theatre reviews, show recommendations and stage-related features.
- [Comedy](https://www.timeout.com/comedy): Comedy show listings, stand-up coverage and performer features.
- [Dance](https://www.timeout.com/dance): Dance performances, reviews and movement-focused cultural coverage.
- [Museums](https://www.timeout.com/museums): Museum guides, exhibition highlights and institution recommendations.
- [Attractions](https://www.timeout.com/attractions): Landmark, sightseeing and visitor attraction recommendations.
- [Shopping](https://www.timeout.com/shopping): Shopping guides covering stores, markets and retail neighborhoods.

## Food, Drink & Nightlife
- [Restaurants](https://www.timeout.com/restaurants): Restaurant reviews, best-of lists and dining guides.
- [Bars](https://www.timeout.com/bars): Bar recommendations, cocktail spots and drinking guides.
- [Cafés](https://www.timeout.com/cafes): Café and coffee shop recommendations for work, brunch and casual visits.
- [Nightlife](https://www.timeout.com/nightlife): Nightlife guides covering clubs, late-night venues and going-out ideas.
- [Food & Drink News](https://www.timeout.com/food-and-drink): Editorial coverage of openings, trends and dining culture.
- [Time Out Market](https://www.timeout.com/discover-timeout-markets): Food hall destinations featuring local chefs, bars and cultural programming.

## Entertainment
- [Movies](https://www.timeout.com/movies): Film criticism, rankings, release coverage and cinema features.
- [Music](https://www.timeout.com/music): Music journalism covering concerts, albums and artist interviews.
- [TV](https://www.timeout.com/tv): Television recommendations, reviews and streaming-related features.
- [Books](https://www.timeout.com/books): Book recommendations, literary features and reading lists.
- [Kids](https://www.timeout.com/kids): Family-friendly activities, events and guides for children.
- [LGBTQ+](https://www.timeout.com/lgbt): LGBTQ+ nightlife, culture and community-focused recommendations.

## Travel & Stay
- [Travel](https://www.timeout.com/travel): Destination inspiration and practical travel-focused editorial coverage.
- [Hotels](https://www.timeout.com/hotels): Hotel roundups and accommodation recommendations in major cities.
- [Beaches](https://www.timeout.com/beaches): Beach guides and coastal destination recommendations.
- [Weekend Breaks](https://www.timeout.com/travel/weekend-breaks): Short-trip ideas and getaway inspiration for travelers.
- [City Breaks](https://www.timeout.com/travel/city-breaks): Urban travel recommendations for quick and culture-focused trips.
- [Road Trips](https://www.timeout.com/travel/road-trips): Scenic route ideas and road-trip planning inspiration.

## Time Out Market
- [Discover Time Out Markets](https://www.timeout.com/discover-timeout-markets): Overview of Time Out Market locations, food and cultural programming.
- [Time Out Market New York](https://www.timeoutmarket.com/newyork/): Official site for the New York market location and vendors.
- [Time Out Market Chicago](https://www.timeoutmarket.com/chicago/): Official site for the Chicago market location and events.
- [Time Out Market Boston](https://www.timeoutmarket.com/boston/): Official site for the Boston market location and dining lineup.
- [Time Out Market Montreal](https://www.timeoutmarket.com/montreal/): Official site for the Montreal market and featured chefs.
- [Time Out Market Dubai](https://www.timeoutmarket.com/dubai/): Official site for the Dubai market experience and programming.
- [Time Out Market Cape Town](https://www.timeoutmarket.com/capetown/): Official site for the Cape Town market location and offerings.

- [Things to Do](https://www.timeout.com/things-to-do): Editorial discovery hub for bookable activities and attractions.
- [Attractions](https://www.timeout.com/attractions): Recommendations for major sights and visitor experiences.
- [Theatre](https://www.timeout.com/theatre): Stage coverage useful for discovering current productions and performances.
